text:
morgan: CI red on master — 12 snapshot/golden failures in serializer tests (job serial-tests/portrait). Happened right after the newline-normalize patch. Anyone able to triage? Need rerun vs bisect vs rollback.

dev-ci-bot: build 1860002467 (master @ commit 9d4f2b) failed — 12 tests failed. Logs: <https://ci.internal.redwood/1860002467|view logs>

tara: saw the failures in morning, looks like prompt spacing + JSON-escaped strings changed. Suspect #3456 (normalize-newlines) — maybe changed serialization of trailing \n.

chen: repro locally, running: ```./scripts/run_snaps.sh --job serial-tests/portrait --commit 9d4f2b``` Got same 12 diffs. Pasting 2 quick diffs:
```
- "assistant:\nHello"
+ "assistant: \
Hello"
```

sam: hmm that spacing in front of colon is suspicious — could be a tokenizer change in tokenizer.py line 128. @elena any recent tokenizer tweaks?

elena: I touched tokenizer.normalizer last week but only in whitespace trimming. I'll run a bisect on master now: `git bisect start --replay -- ./scripts/run_snaps.sh` — will update.

morgan: for speed can someone rerun the CI job with `RERUN_SNAP=1` to confirm flake vs regression? If consistent then bisect/rollback.

tara: rerun kicked off: <https://ci.internal.redwood/runs/1860002499|rerun link>. If rerun shows same diffs, request @eng-oncall to hold merging until fix.

chen: rerun completed — same 12 diffs. Starting bisect now and will ping with first bad commit.

chen: bisect found first bad commit 9d4f2b — it's the newline normalize change. Suggest revert or patch serializer to be newline-agnostic for snapshots. :thinking_face: 

morgan: thanks. I'll open a quick PR to revert the normalize and add a test for both CR/LF. Assigning to @elena for follow-up.

elena: ack, will follow up with patch to tokenizer and add snapshot variants. Thanks team :thumbsup:
